liquidations.appsOff: A settlement needs the Budgets and payments and Professionals apps. While either is off, settlements already issued can be read and paid, but no new one is calculated.
liquidations.collectedHint: What the patient has already paid for it
liquidations.issueWhy: Issuing freezes the figures: what the patient pays afterwards does not change what was settled.
liquidations.noWork: No work by this professional in the period.

commission.title: Arrangement with the professional
commission.basisHint: On collected, the clinic never pays out money it has not received. On earned, the associate carries none of the collection risk.
commission.note: The arrangement can be changed whenever needed: settlements already issued keep the percentage they were made with.
commission.missing: No arrangement recorded with this professional
commission.missingWhy: The work figures are real; the percentage is zero until somebody says otherwise. Record it before settling.

pay.title: Pay the settlement
pay.methodHint: Cash comes out of the drawer and is recorded as a till movement. A transfer never touches it.
pay.undoFailed: Could not undo. If the day has been counted, it has to be reopened first.
